invariants.rationale: A valid HoodieEngineContext is generally required to coordinate Spark/Java execution in Hudi table operations.
An instant (timestamp) must be specified to create a valid savepoint.
User information is generally required to track who triggered the savepoint.
A comment is usually required for savepoint traceability, or at a minimum, not expected to be null during savepoint creation.
A non-empty string is expected for the instant to savepoint, as an empty instant would be invalid.
